description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for DOMParser producing a parsererror element for malformed application/xml while text/html auto-corrects without error. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/wpt_b/dom_domparser`, and the server-side grader compares it with the Chrome-baked expected answer.
title: DOMParser XML parsererror vs HTML tolerance
